treated_rule: tutoring_school == True (constant within unit in every row)
treatment_start_source: data/README_school_tutoring.md: 'Some schools introduced a tutoring programme from the 2017 school year'. No timing column exists in the data.
post_definition: 1[year >= 2017], built from treatment_start; no ready-made post column in data
notes: tutoring_school is constant within unit, so it is a group flag, not a post indicator; the interaction treated x post is constructed here.
